title: Design: Inactive tag in the vendor return lookup looks as drawn
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have an inactive part, part A, and an active part, part B, both with stock.
  • Give parts A and B part numbers that start with the same text, so one search lists both.
  • Make sure the app is in the Light theme.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1600 pixels wide with the page zoom at 100%, so the screen is as wide as the design boards.
  • Open the attached design picture of board 6.6 at 100% zoom, so you can compare the screen with it.
  • Start on the Create Return page (Parts in the top bar, Returns in the left menu, then start a new return).
custom_steps:
1. Type the shared start of the part numbers in the Part Number box.
  2. Press Escape.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Both parts are offered.
  • Part A's result shows a small grey rounded "Inactive" tag right after its description, before its part number.
  • Part B's result has no tag; its description runs straight to its part number.

Step 2:

  • The lookup list closes and the Part Number box of the return line is still empty.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10822 (Story 9, Inactive Parts Cannot Be Added to New Work)

  • S9-R11: “Part lookup on a vendor return and on a vendor credit includes inactive parts.”
  • S9-R12: “In those lookups an inactive part carries a grey "Inactive" tag beside its description.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Parts Lifecycle Update" (https://claude.ai/artifact/Vz6rprcWyP16tYxzM1kdeE), 13 Oct 2026 copy, unchanged when re-read on 27 Oct 2026: board "6.6 Vendor return: still offered, tagged". Compare the screen with the pictures below; the expected results above come from the quotes above where the PRD speaks, and from the board pictures where it is silent about the look.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • daily-06-p6-4-return-tag.png

The design's own words:

  • “The vendor return lookup includes inactive parts (S9-R11), because stock may still need to go back. The inactive one carries a grey "Inactive" tag beside its description (S9-R12).”
